subject: Your gut feeling at 2AM on Day 65
preview_text: Right now is the perfect time to use this one feature that 800+ users rely on.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you're lying in bed at 2AM, replaying a conversation in your head, wondering if something was off? That moment when your gut whispers 'something's wrong' but your brain says 'maybe I'm overthinking.' That split-second hesitation is the most honest part of you. And right now, on Day 65 of using Red Flag Scanner AI, that hesitation is not random—it's a signal.

Here's what 800+ users have learned: ignoring that feeling costs you months of heartache. But acting on it? That's how you break cycles. The problem is, most people wait until they're drowning in doubt to check patterns. But the smartest users don't wait—they scan the moment they feel uneasy. And right now, with Valentine's season heating up and late-night texts flying, the air is thick with red flags disguised as love.

That's where the 'Screenshot & Scan' feature becomes your secret weapon. Open Red Flag Scanner AI, screenshot that 2AM text you're overthinking, and let the AI give you a real-time toxicity score. It'll flag gaslighting, love bombing, or manipulation you might miss in the heat of the moment. No one knows you're doing it. It's just you and your truth.

Open the app and scan that one conversation you've been avoiding. Do it before 2AM hits again. P.S. The pattern detection feature can show you if this is a one-time slip or a recurring pattern—most users discover their biggest red flag is one they've been repeating for months.
